answer.thought: The gate closes at half-past, and the air is turning sharp. I bought a bottle of water at the stall, a small concession to the body that has carried me nine kilometres today. I must go home; the hunger is no longer a sensation but a fact, and I have not eaten since yesterday. The walk back will be long in the dark, but the body obeys the will to rest, even if it complains along the way.
